svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Monthly sea ice extent in the Arctic
Each point represents the monthly average sea ice extent. Years in the current decade are highlighted in red,
with the current year highlighted in black.

tspan.tspan: National Snow and Ice Data Center - Sea Ice Index (2026)
All years have data for all 12 months, except 1987 and 1988 (each missing one month) and the current year.
